evidence: Has the Validation label and modifies block file storage and pruning logic during disk flushes in src/validation.cpp and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a disk space leak where files scheduled for pruning are forgotten if FlushStateToDisk fails before the block index write. The issue is an edge-case bug that automatically recovers on restart when ScanAndUnlinkAlreadyPrunedFiles runs, making resolution worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
